(667)yid bzhin 'khor lo'i phrin las bzhugs/(668)dpa' mo gcig mar sgrub na/skyabs 'gro ni/a/skye ba med pa chos skyi sku/nges pa lnga ldan longs spa

tei:div.tei:p: dpa' mo gcig mar sgrub na/ skyabs 'gro ni/ a/ skye ba med pa chos skyi sku/ nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo mar/ gnyis su med par skyabs su mchi/ sems bskyed pa ni/ a/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun/ rmongs 'khrul las kyis 'khyams pa rnams/ rang byung ye shes rmad po che/ smon dang 'jug (669)pa'i sems mchog bskyed/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ a/ 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams/ thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs/ rin chen mjes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ nyams chag 'khrul pa mthol lo bshags/ rgyal sras (670)spyod la rjes yi rang*/ bla med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ 'gro mgon mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ sku dang ye shes yongs 'grub shog dngos gzhi dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ āḥ gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sems/ ma rtogs sems can snying re rje/ skye ba med pa'i cho 'phrul las/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ rab 'byams zhing gi bkod pa'i klong*/ lhun grub sprul pa'i gzhal med khang*/ rgya khyon blo las 'das pa'i dbus/ (671)pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus/ rig pa tām̐ yig yongs gyur pas/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ pad+ma rgyas pa las byung zhing*/ zla ba rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ zla ba'i rgyab yol la brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis/ mi mthun phyogs las sgrol bar mjad/ g.yon pa skyabs sbyin mtheb mjub kyis/ ut+pal lar gnas tshe bum 'jin/ rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas brgyan/ tshe dang ye shes (672)dngos grub bdag 'gro la thugs rjes mi yol bar/ ye shes spyan bdun pa ler gsal/ mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu'i tshul/ gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi byin ldan/ rgyan cha bcu gsum dag gis spras/

sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab cing*/ pad+ma dkar po grangs med par/ sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'jin dang*/ rig sngags grub pa bye ba 'phro/ lha dgu mar bskyed na shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma nas bstod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin btang*/ min na/ gdan gsum rdo rje'i bdag nyid can/ (673)ye nas lhun gyis grub par gsal/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ āḥ mkhyen brtse ye shes gzigs par ldan/ tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma/ shar phyogs ri bo ta la nas/ rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis gshegs su gsol/ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tṛ sh+ya hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ a/ ye nas bde gshegs snying po la/ dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med/ mnyam rdzogs blo las 'das pa la/ mngon sum rig pas phyag 'tshal lo/ (674) mchod pa ni/ āḥ sems nyid yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gter/ tshogs drug yul gyi snang cha kun/ kun bzang mchod sprin bla na med/ nam mkha' mjod kyi 'khor lor 'bul/ badz+ra ru pa shab+da/ ghan+dhe/ rā pa/ spar+she/ dharmā dhartu ma hā sarba pū tsa āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa ni/ āḥ snying rje chen po las sprul zhing*/ bzhad cing rab dkar 'jug pa'i zhal/ 'od zer sprin gyi dkyil 'khor na/ bzhugs pa yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bsnyen pa ni/ āḥ thugs kar pad zla la (675)gnas pa'i/ 'od kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus/ tām̐ la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba mchod/ sems can don byas 'khor 'das kyi/ dwangs ma bdag la thim pa yis/ dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sel/ mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ ma ma ā yu pan+yai dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru swā hā/ nye ba'i rtsa sngags/ rtsa sngags la/ ku ru sarba pā pam̐ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar la bzla'o/ sgrub pa'i sngags/ (676)a oṃ tā re a/ a tut+tā re a/ a tu re a swā hā/ las la sbyor ba sgrol ma'i rig sngags byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal kyi thugs dam du bzung ba'i sngags/

a ba na ji ti/ nā ga pa re/ na hī le/ ja hi le/ ja hi la ba te/ tsa rī la ba te swā hā/ ci mang du bzla'o/ phan yon ni/ mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga/ sdang dang rmi lam ngan pa zhi/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ mi khom brgyad du nam yang min/ rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang*/ dbang po gsal dang yid gzhungs 'gyur/ bzo gnas dag la mkhas pa thob/ (677)(678) stobs dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis/ srung dang skyobs dang phan bde byed/ gang du gnas kyang bkra shis 'gyur/ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ rten ni bla med so lnga'i bcud kyis gtams pa'i bum pa dang*/ 'khor lo logs su gsal ba ltar ro/ zhes pa'ang chos kyi bden po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba'o/// /
